calibration_sources: Prompt Peek / Leaky Cache: Timing Side-Channel Attacks on Shared LLM Prefix Caches (RadixAttention / vLLM APC)
vLLM / SGLang Multi-Tenant Prefix Cache Isolation (`lora_name` / `cache_salt` / Tenant-Keyed Block Hashing)
Hierarchical Public-Root + Tenant-HMAC Subtree Prefix Caching & Ephemeral AES-GCM KV Offload Encryption

workload_baseline.cluster: 32x H100 80GB SXM5 ($80/hr), 200 Enterprise Tenants on Shared 70B Serving Pool
workload_baseline.prompt_profile: 2,048 public SDK template tokens + 4,096 private tenant RAG tokens + 512 query tokens

tiers.name: Tier 1: Global Unisolated Radix / APC Prefix Cache (Content-Only Block Hash Shared Across All Tenants)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 全局无隔离共享前缀缓存 (仅按 Token 内容哈希：攻击者通过 42ms vs 520ms TTFT 差值逐块猜出邻居机密)
tiers.mechanism: Hashes 16-token KV blocks purely by token IDs globally; any tenant probing a matching prefix observes a 12.4x faster TTFT

tiers.name: Tier 2: Completely Disable Prefix Caching for Multi-Tenant Safety (--no-enable-prefix-caching)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 因噎废食彻底关闭 Prefix Cache (安全归零，但每笔请求被迫重算 6.6K 前缀，TTFT 暴涨 4.5 倍)
tiers.mechanism: Disables KV prefix reuse completely to stop timing attacks, forcing full 6,656-token prefill on every request

tiers.name: Tier 3: Global Prefix Cache + Random TTFT Jitter Padding (Artificial 50–300ms Delay Noise -> easily averaged out)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 全局缓存 + 首字随机延迟注入混淆 (人工加 50~300ms 噪声：不仅拖慢正常用户，攻击者连测 10 次求均值即可破防)
tiers.mechanism: Adds synthetic random sleep before returning first token on cache hits; attacker bypasses via N=10 repeated sample averaging

tiers.name: Tier 4: Two-Tier Cryptographic Namespace Tree (Public Signed System Root + Tenant-HMAC Private Subtree + AES-GCM Offload)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 双层密码学哈希前缀树 (平台签名公共系统根节点共享 + 租户 HMAC 密钥隔离私有子树 + 卸载块 AES-GCM 加密)
tiers.mechanism: Shares admin-signed public system templates at Layer-0 root, but keys all tenant blocks with HMAC-SHA256(tenant_key, parent_hash || tokens)

security_perturbation.scenario: B2B Document Existence Probing (Does Competitor X Have Merger Contract Y in Cache?)
security_perturbation.diagnosis: 1st probe on 4K contract yields 42ms TTFT (vs 520ms miss) in Tier 1; Tier 4 HMAC-SHA256 isolates tenant namespace 100%

security_perturbation.scenario: Token-by-Token Autoregressive Prompt Extraction (16-Token Block Dictionary Search)
security_perturbation.diagnosis: Attacker brute-forces candidate 16-token blocks at tree frontier; Tier 4 prevents cross-tenant hash collisions

security_perturbation.scenario: Cache Eviction Side-Channel (Prime+Probe via HBM LRU Quota Exhaustion)
security_perturbation.diagnosis: Tier 4 enforces per-tenant min/max HBM KV watermark quotas so Tenant A cannot evict Tenant B's active prefix blocks

security_perturbation.scenario: Shared NVMe / CXL L2 KV Offload Bus Snooping & Cold-Reboot Remanence
security_perturbation.diagnosis: Tier 4 encrypts offloaded KV blocks with ephemeral per-tenant AES-256-GCM keys in CPU/NIC before writing to NVMe/3FS
